name: Constellation Brands

logo.source: cbrands.com site header PNG (380x50, logo-cbrands-black); Wikipedia's infobox file Constellation Brands Logo.png (300x60, 2012) is the same mark

description: Constellation Brands is, in practice, the US importer and seller of Mexican beer: Modelo Especial (the best-selling beer in the US per its 10-K), Corona Extra, Pacifico and Victoria are brewed in Mexico at its own breweries and sold through US wholesale distributors. Beer was 91% of Fiscal 2026 net sales ($8.3B of $9.1B) and $3.16B of the $3.17B combined segment operating income; wine and spirits (Kim Crawford, The Prisoner, Robert Mondavi and others) is now a small residual after the June 2025 sale of its mainstream wine brands. Money comes from wholesalers buying cases and kegs at a set price; growth depends on brewery capacity (over $700M spent in Fiscal 2026 on brewery expansion, about $800M expected in Fiscal 2027). It also holds Exchangeable Shares of Canopy Growth Corporation (Ontario-based).

sub.name: Drinks (soft drinks, energy drinks, beer and spirits)

gics.note: Conventional filing: sector and sub-industry from Wikipedia's List of S&P 500 companies (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30); industry group and industry not on that page, so null. EDGAR SIC 2080 (Beverages). See conflicts: the GICS box says wine and spirits, but about 91% of FY2026 net sales and essentially all profit are Mexican-import beer.

hq.note: EDGAR business address Rochester, NY; same in Wikipedia S&P 500 list

employees.note: Approximately 9,400, including about 1,100 employed through the equally owned joint venture with Owens-Illinois (glass plant); count varies with grape-crush seasons (FY2026 10-K)

businessLines.name: Beer
businessLines.how: US wholesale distributors buy beer at a set price per case and resell to retailers, bars and restaurants; revenue moves with shipment volume and annual price increases, and profit with aluminum, glass and grain costs and the cost of adding brewery capacity.
businessLines.description: Modelo (Especial, Chelada, Negra, Oro, Noche Especial, Spiked Aguas Frescas), Corona (Extra, Light, Premier, Familiar, Sunbrew, Non-Alcoholic), Pacifico and Victoria, brewed in Nava and Obregon, Mexico (a third brewery is under construction in Veracruz) and sold mainly in the US.

operatingProfit.note: Operating income: gross profit $4,361.5M less SG&A $1,200.5M. Fiscal 2025 $3,394.4M on $8,539.8M net sales (-3% sales, -7% operating income). Share is of Beer plus Wine and Spirits operating income, before $228.3M corporate cost. Q1 Fiscal 2027 (to 2026-05-31) Beer net sales $2,283.5M.

businessLines.marketShare: Per the 10-K: Modelo Especial was the best-selling beer overall in the US, Corona Extra the second largest imported beer and fifth best-selling beer overall; 6 of the top 15 share-gaining beer brands. No percentage share given.

businessLines.name: Wine and Spirits
businessLines.how: US wholesale distributors buy cases of premium wine and spirits (and some direct-to-consumer and state-run stores buy); revenue depends on brand pricing and volume, and the segment is now near break-even after the disposals.
businessLines.description: Premium wine and spirits (Kim Crawford, Ruffino, The Prisoner Wine Company, Robert Mondavi Winery, Mi CAMPO tequila and others) after the 2025 wine divestitures (June 2, 2025 sale, with exclusive trademark licences, of the mainstream wine brands, wineries and vineyards); SVEDKA vodka was sold on January 6, 2025.

operatingProfit.note: Down 97% from $325.1M in Fiscal 2025; net sales -51% from $1,668.9M. Q1 Fiscal 2027 net sales $149.2M.

businessLines.marketShare: Per the 10-K: 5 of the 100 top-selling higher-end US wine brands, with Kim Crawford 8th. No percentage share given.
